name: Ajax Product Search for WooCommerce (ProSearch)
author: ProSearch

sections.description:
ProSearch is a modern Ajax Product Search plugin for WooCommerce that helps customers find products instantly, improves user experience, and can increase store conversions.

It replaces the slow default WooCommerce search with real-time live results, smart relevance ranking, SKU search, and typo-tolerant fuzzy matching—all built on a high-performance indexed search engine designed to scale from small shops to stores with 100,000+ products.

Why Replace Default WooCommerce Search?

The default WooCommerce search:

  • Does not provide real-time Ajax results
  • Struggles with typos and partial matches
  • Cannot reliably search SKUs or attributes
  • Becomes slow on large product catalogs

ProSearch solves these problems with fast, accurate, and intelligent live search.

Key Features

Fast Live Ajax Search

  • Instant product results while typing
  • No page reloads
  • Smooth mobile-friendly experience

Smart & Accurate Matching

  • Fuzzy typo correction and partial matching
  • Full SKU, category, tag, and attribute search
  • Relevance-based result ordering

Built for Performance & Scale

  • Dedicated indexed search table for speed
  • Optimized for large WooCommerce catalogs
  • Automatic sync when products change

Flexible Display & Integration

  • Shortcode and widget support
  • Product images, prices, descriptions, and SKUs in results
  • Compatible with major themes and page builders

Multilingual & Analytics Ready

  • Works with WPML, Polylang, and WooCommerce Multilingual
  • Google Analytics search tracking support

This architecture delivers fast, reliable, and scalable search performance even for very large WooCommerce stores.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin in Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Configure settings in ProSearch.
  4. Add the search form using the shortcode or page-builder widget.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin replace the default WooCommerce search?

Yes. ProSearch upgrades or replaces the default WooCommerce search with a fast, Intelligent relevance ordering Ajax product search that delivers instant and highly relevant results.

How does the Product Index Table work?

ProSearch creates a dedicated index table that stores product titles, SKUs, categories, tags, attributes, and meta fields. This structure ensures lightning-fast search queries even for large WooCommerce stores.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No. The optimized index table and smart caching ensure that search queries are handled instantly
while keeping server load extremely low.

Is ProSearch compatible with Elementor, Divi, or other builders?

Yes. ProSearch includes a native Elementor widget and works smoothly with Divi, Bricks, Beaver Builder, Gutenberg, WPBakery, Oxygen, and all major theme builders.

Can I show the search bar anywhere?

Yes. You can place the search bar using the shortcode [mpsfw_search_form] or use the page-builder widgets included with the plugin.

Do I need to rebuild the index manually?

No. The index updates automatically when products are added, edited, or deleted. A manual rebuild option is available for full control.

Is ProSearch compatible with multilingual websites?

Yes. It works with WPML, Polylang, WooCommerce Multilingual, qTranslate, and other translation plugins.

Does it support variable and attribute-based products?

Yes. Variations, attributes, and complex product data are indexed automatically for accurate results.

How does this search engine differ from other Ajax search plugins?

ProSearch includes features such as Adaptive relevance logic scoring, fuzzy matching, and an optimized index table that work differently from the default WooCommerce search and other search plugins like FiboSearch. Actual performance depends on your store’s data, size, and configuration.

Does ProSearch work on websites with large product catalogs?

Yes. The search engine is designed to handle large WooCommerce stores with 50,000–100,000+ products while keeping searches fast and accurate.
